Overview.Name: THURAGA RAHUL REDDY
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (80–100 g) pan fried in ghee
Option 2: Thick curd bowl (250 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small portion) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (80 g) + vegetable curry (no cabbage, no brinjal)
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + chicken curry (small portion, once or twice per week only) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + curd + vegetable curry
Evening_Snack: Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (2 cups, lightly salted)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + paneer curry (small portion)
Option 2: Thick curd bowl + vegetable curry
Option 3: Vegetable soup (no corn, no potato) + paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Start every meal with paneer, curd or chicken before eating rice.
Limit rice portions and avoid second servings.
Avoid sweets, fruit juices and bakery foods completely.
Fix dinner before 9 pm. Late nights worsen sugar control.
Aim for 7 hours sleep to improve insulin sensitivity and stress levels.
With consistency, expect gradual fat loss and better sugar control in 8–12 weeks.
